description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-11-12)

### ✨ New Features

* Add Pingo and Chessbook patches ([105ef71](https://github.com/thebugsmith/bugsmith-morphe-patches/commit/105ef71906bdfc6baf0cb50638c2a03bfeaa0f89))

patches.name: Chessbook local gates
patches.description: Remove local move admission/locks, skip optional onboarding account/link prompts and disable automatic OTA. Server auth/billing and explicit login remain unchanged.

patches.name: Pingo Google login
patches.description: Replaces the signature-bound GMS Google Sign-In with a browser OAuth code flow (PKCE) against the app's own installed-app OAuth client so Google login works on a re-signed build.

patches.name: Pingo Google login (manifest)
patches.description: Registers the OAuth redirect activity and its com.googleusercontent.apps intent filter so the browser-based Google login can receive the authorization code.

patches.name: Pingo Premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium features by bypassing Superwall paywall checks.
